about_short_description.short_description: Draftbit is a software company that develops customized solutions to build cross-platform, native iOS and Android apps.

product.name: Draftbit Visual App Builder
product.description: A visual development platform for building native iOS and Android mobile apps using drag-and-drop components without coding.

product.name: Draftbit Experts
product.description: A service providing access to a team of designers, developers, and app-building experts to assist with app development projects.

product.name: Launch Guarantee Program
product.description: A program offering step-by-step guidance, personalized support, and daily iterations to help users build and launch their app with reduced risk.

product.name: Custom Code Integration
product.description: A feature allowing developers to add custom JavaScript, create unique components, and integrate third-party libraries within Draftbit apps.

product.name: Seamless Data Integration
product.description: Tools to connect Draftbit apps with external data sources via REST APIs, including support for popular backends and automatic endpoint configuration.

product.name: One-Click Publishing
product.description: A deployment feature that enables users to publish their Draftbit-built apps to iOS and Android app stores or the web with minimal steps.
